title: FLA import: individual display object visible/hidden flag not decoded (only layer visibility decoded)
description: In flash8-import.ts, the visible flag is only decoded for layers (visible: !l.hidden, line ~989). Individual display object elements (shape, bitmap, text, symbol instance) placed on a layer do not have their hidden/visible flag decoded — the Fla8Element types have no hidden/visible property and convertElement never reads or propagates one. When a specific shape or instance is hidden in the Flash authoring tool, it imports as visible. Fix: check the binary element record (CPicSymbolInstance, CPicShape, CPicBitmap, CPicText) for a hidden/visible flag, add to Fla8Element types, and decode in convertElement.
